baseline: original approved composition, no additional 0.92 shrink by default
safe_area: uniform contain within available safe rect
touch_rect_policy: Visual images retain source positions; invisible hit rects only expand. At 360 logical width these rects are >=44dp. Recompute for narrower safe areas; do not permit overlapping targets.
notes: This is an integration contract, not executable project code.
Extra horizontal separator/footer rules visible only in generated target are not supplied as new pixels.
All dynamic labels must bind real values, not reference screenshot values.
